items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was driving home this morning from the gig, and Dick Buckley was playing broadcasts from 1940 of the Ellington band.

ctx.x: Because of the voicing he had. I tried to get that voicing, but that's kind of hard to do.
I was driving home this morning from the gig, and Dick Buckley was playing broadcasts from
1940 of the Ellington band. My, my, my, what a band that was.
